claim.statement: The publisher's README at tag 1.16.0 states that --always-approve, also exposed as --yolo, auto-approves all actions without confirmation.

source.title: OpenHands CLI README at tag 1.16.0
source.locator: Features — Confirmation Modes — Auto-approve all actions

limitations: This is a version-pinned publisher description, not observed behavior.
The catalog did not establish what operating-system, container, repository or credential boundaries remain outside the confirmation layer.
unknowns: The tools and credentials available to a particular always-approve session are unknown.
Whether external containment would block any attempted action is unknown.

relationships.note: The apparent conflict is resolved because always-approve and always-ask are mutually exclusive confirmation configurations.
